{{Quote|I would stay far from that cursed place, my friends. Hutts are spiteful, avaricious creatures. Even in death they guard their treasures unwaveringly; those who go there are likely never to return. Pybus is home to far more than traps, though. The Hutts have given that planet a wide berth for thousands of years. The dead do not rest easy on Pybus&hellip;|[[Harke]]|<ref name="LoNH" />}}
'''Pybus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Pybus is uninhabited, but said to have ancient ruins deep in its jungles, as well as an overly biodiverse ecosystem.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="SW4" />}}
Pybus was a lush [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located deep within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]''. Unpopulated, it was covered with hundreds of ancient ruins. Pybus was considered taboo by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] for mysterious reasons.<ref name="LoNH" />
